title: Community Solar Subscriptions - Plan Schedule: Term Length, Guaranteed Discount and Term End
content:
Beacon Ridge Energy offers Community Solar Subscriptions in six plans. Each plan fixes a subscription term, a guaranteed discount off the value of the utility solar bill credits, an annual escalation of that discount, the treatment of the subscription when the term ends, and the lead time of the term-end notice.

## Schedule by plan

| Plan | Term (months) | Guaranteed discount off bill credit value | Annual escalation of the discount | At term end | Term-end notice sent no later than |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex | 0 (no term) | 5.0% | 0.0% | continues on Flex terms | 60 calendar days before term end |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 1-Year | 12 | 10.0% | 0.0% | continues on Flex terms | 60 calendar days before term end |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 5-Year | 60 | 12.0% | 0.0% | continues on Flex terms | 60 calendar days before term end |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 10-Year | 120 | 15.0% | 0.5% | continues on Flex terms | 60 calendar days before term end |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 20-Year | 240 | 20.0% | 0.5% | continues on Flex terms | 60 calendar days before term end |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible | 0 (no term) | 20.0% | 0.0% | continues on Flex terms | 60 calendar days before term end |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Term.** The term is stated in whole months. A term of 0 means the plan has no term; Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex and Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible are the two plans without a term.
2. **Guaranteed discount.** The discount is a percentage off the value of the solar bill credits the utility applies to the subscriber's utility account, stated to one decimal place.
3. **Escalation.** The escalation figure is the annual escalation of the discount, stated to one decimal place. Only Beacon Ridge Solar Share 10-Year and Beacon Ridge Solar Share 20-Year carry an escalation above 0.0%.
4. **Term end.** On every plan, when the term ends the subscription continues on Flex terms.
5. **Term-end notice.** The term-end notice is sent no later than 60 calendar days before the term ends.

## Reading the schedule

- *Which plans share the deepest discount?* Beacon Ridge Solar Share 20-Year and Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible both carry a 20.0% discount; the 20-Year plan has a 240-month term and a 0.5% escalation, the Income-Eligible plan has no term and no escalation.
- *Which plan carries the smallest discount?* Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex, at 5.0%.
- *Hypothetical illustration of the notice lead time:* for a term that ends on a hypothetical 30 June, the term-end notice is sent no later than 1 May, which is 60 calendar days earlier.
